contract: The manifest names concrete implemented rule families and independent evidence; it does not claim complete HTML/SVG/MathML semantic conformance. Local suite runs enforce upstream tree construction expectations without suppressing mismatches.

rules.details: Balanced names, quoting, duplicate attributes, character/entity references, line endings, CDATA and character-data coalescence; retain comments and processing instructions. DTDs rejected.
Expanded names, explicit namespace shadowing/undeclaration, prefix bindings and duplicate expanded attribute names.
Documents/fragments, context and scripting flags, optional tags, void elements, table insertion/foster parenting, active formatting/adoption, templates, foreign integration and recovery.
rules.acceptance_gate: Every selected parser-only upstream expectation is compared, including both scripting modes when required; crashes and mismatches fail.

rules.details: Character references, raw text/RCDATA/script-data, comments, doctypes and processing instructions; strict rejection is separate from standard recovery.
HTML case adjustment and namespace transitions at SVG/MathML integration points, distinguished from explicit XML namespace rules.

Known/current element and attribute vocabulary, custom element names, global/data/ARIA names; boolean/enumerated values, selected numeric/token values and common parent/interactive/required-attribute rules. This is not a complete conformance checker.

SVG2 element/attribute names with exact XML case, common SVG1.1 compatibility names and xlink href; selected container restrictions. Recognizing an attribute does not imply validation of all its value semantics.
All absolute/relative path command families, initial moveto, implicit repetitions, numeric grammar, command arity, arc flags and nonnegative radii. Layout/geometric evaluation is not performed.

Numbers, nonnegative dimensions, lengths/units, lists, transforms, viewBox/aspect ratio, paint/color and selected filter/presentation/animation keywords and numeric values. Complex CSS and timing grammars outside these checks are opaque.

Core and common Presentation vocabulary, fixed-arity fractions/roots/scripts, multiscript pairs, table cells/rows and semantics annotations; selected enumerated/number/length attributes. Full Content MathML symbolic validation is not provided.

Original arbitrary bytes and partitioned spans remain distinct from normalized/repaired tree nodes. Implied nodes have insertion origins. Source retention does not promise normalized-tree serialization.
Runtime parsing and typed quotations use the same format validation/options. Compiler rejection fixtures assert the intended diagnostic, including imported text.

Indexed character-data and whole quoted attribute slots retain generic values; structural/namespace/raw-language positions rejected. Static values are validated; dynamic values keep explicit expected grammars and are never interpreted as markup.

Syntax recovery, unknown element/attribute preservation, and value-check relaxation are independent. Unknown extension acceptance records diagnostics; disabling value checks is an explicit prop and does not establish that skipped checks passed. Original source bytes remain unchanged.

opaque.contract: Retain style blocks, style attributes and recognized attributes with unimplemented complex CSS value grammars without claiming full CSS validation.
Retain script/event source as inert text; no JavaScript evaluation or DOM mutation during parsing.
Retain authored values; no resource fetching, ID-reference resolution across documents or rendering proof.
Can be preserved through unknown-extension props; strict defaults reject unknown symbolic vocabulary rather than promising symbolic semantics.
